prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: low-speed head-on collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: neck and back strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1329; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was driving home on a weekday afternoon when the car in front of me slowed and drifted into my lane, and despite braking hard, we ended up in a low-speed head-on collision. Neither vehicle was going fast, but the impact pushed me forward and back against my seat, and I felt an immediate stiffness in my neck and a dull ache across my lower back. I got out of the car and spoke with the other driver and the responding officer, and I have given the same account of what happened every time I have been asked since then. I am the named driver on this policy and I am reporting the collision so that my medical care and vehicle repairs can be handled. I am seeing a doctor about the neck and back strain and will provide records as they become available.
